question: At which location is the second phase of Exercise** Tarang Shakti 24** was conducted? (September 2024)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Air Force Station Jodhpur.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The second phase of Exercise Tarang Shakti 24 was held at Air Force Station Jodhpur.**
 
• This phase of the exercise ran from August 30 to September 13.
 
• Participating nations include** Australia, Greece, Sri Lanka, the UAE, Japan, Singapore, and the United States.**
 
• Australia has deployed three EA-18G Growler aircraft and up to 120 personnel for this exercise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The first phase of Exercise Tarang Shakti took place in Tamil Nadu in August.**
 
• **Exercise Tarang Shakti is India’s largest multilateral air exercise.**
 
• Australia’s participation in this exercise highlights the country's commitment to regional stability and interoperability.
 
• Exercise Tarang Shakti includes multiple nations to foster international cooperation in addressing security challenges.
